monitor.description: Enable or disable monitoring of cache and memory bandwidth.

device_path.description: Path to the RDT (Resource Director Technology) device. Usually /dev/rdt.

max_clos.description: Maximum number of Cache Monitoring (CLOS) groups the system supports.

monitors.description: List of monitoring groups (CLOS), each mapping to a set of process IDs to monitor.

clos_id.description: CLOS (Class of Service) identifier for this monitoring group.

processes.description: List of process IDs (PIDs) to associate with this CLOS for monitoring.

poll_interval_ms.description: Interval (in milliseconds) at which monitoring data is sampled.

detailed_cache_mon.description: Enable or disable collection of detailed per-level cache metrics (L1, L2, L3).

log_file.description: File path where monitoring logs and reports will be written.
